verdicts.title: Some factorization results for formal power series
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: In this paper, we obtain some factorization results on formal power series over principle ideal domains with sharp bounds on number of irreducible factors. These factorization results correspondingly lead to irreducibility criteria for formal power series. verdicts.title: On Quotients of Formal Power Series
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: Quotient is a basic operation of formal languages, which plays a key role in the construction of minimal deterministic finite automata (DFA) and the universal automata. In this paper, we extend this operation to formal power series and systemically investigate its implications in the study of weighted automata. verdicts.title: Geometric location of periodic points of 2-ramified power series
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: In this paper we study the geometric location of periodic points of power series defined over fields of prime characteristic $p$. More specifically, we find a lower bound for the absolute value of all periodic points in the open unit disk of minimal period $p^n$ of 2-ramified power series.
